scope: Collections in Scotland, with destinations across Britain. Service timing, access, vehicle and crew subject to assessment of the actual enquiry.
editorialMethod: Individually authored local guidance. Official sources establish specified place names, local access-reference locations, or where to check current conditions. Packing, inventories and handling recommendations are editorial operational guidance, not claimed council advice or evidence of completed company jobs.
limitations: No search volume or commercial demand data was available.
No completed moves, reviews, photographs, prices, depot addresses or driver allocations were invented.
All postcodes deliberately blank: customers must provide the precise booking address.
Place schema is used for all 32 settlements.
Nearby links are navigational geographic suggestions; no fixed mileage, travel duration or service availability is implied.
Direct access to the historical Prestonpans strategy PDF was blocked (403); only official indexed extracts were used.
The historical Loanhead plan URL returned 404 and was excluded from published source links.
Council directories locate public parking but do not grant removal loading permission or establish vehicle suitability.
